question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
-- Find the team with fewest wins per league, picking one in case of ties
WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT l.name as league, t.team_long_name, 
           CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
               SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    GROUP BY l.name, t.team_long_name
)
SELECT league, team_long_name, total_wins
FROM team_wins
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league ORDER BY total_wins, team_long_name) = 1
ORDER BY league
